violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Refrigerator inside unit was set to 1 causing the temp to be 53-57F. All foods sent to landfill
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. - Hand sink leaking not able to use.
Handwashing lavatories. — --- Hand wash station unable to be used to to leak, per staff washing hands in building restroom.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. - Found bucket at 10ppm CL, needs to be 100ppm CL
Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Refrigerator in unit found at 50F

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitizer solution for three compartment sink was not maintained at the proper concentration. - Not in use at time of inspection, Staff was washing dishes.
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
